lines.text: The man who isolates himself pursues selfish desires, and a fool delights only in airing his opinions.
A fool's lips bring him strife, his mouth is his ruin, and a gossip's words go down into the inmost being.
The name of the LORD is a strong tower, and a rich man's wealth is a high wall in his imagination.
Before his downfall a man's heart is proud, and answering a matter before hearing it is folly; a broken spirit is hard to survive.
Life and death are in the power of the tongue, and a man who finds a wife obtains favor from the LORD.
